This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Commands

### Development
- `npm run dev` - Start Next.js development server
- `npm run build` - Build production version
- `npm start` - Start production server
- `npm run lint` - Run ESLint
- `npm run typecheck` - Run TypeScript type checking
- `npm test` - Run Jest test suites
- `npm run test:watch` - Run tests in watch mode
- `npm run test:coverage` - Run tests with coverage report

### Environment
The application requires Airtable integration. Key environment variables:
- `AIRTABLE_API_KEY` - Airtable API key
- `AIRTABLE_BASE_ID` - Base ID for the Airtable workspace
- `AIRTABLE_TABLE_QUOTES` - Table name for quotes (default: "Quote Requests")
- `AIRTABLE_TABLE_LINE_ITEMS` - Table name for line items (default: "Quote Line Items")
- `AIRTABLE_FIELD_TOKEN` - Field name for tokens (default: "Token")
- `AIRTABLE_FIELD_QUOTE_ID_LOOKUP` - Lookup field (default: "Quote ID (from Request)")
- `AIRTABLE_FIELD_LINK_TO_QUOTE` - Linked record field name
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE` - Optional API base URL for client-side fetching

## Architecture

### Core Structure
This is a Next.js 14 App Router application that serves as a quote viewer for Handld services, integrating with Airtable as the backend data store.

### Key Components
- **Quote Viewer** (`/app/q/[token]/page.tsx`) - Main customer-facing quote display with pricing tiers (standard vs. member pricing)
- **LineItemsTable Component** (`/app/components/LineItemsTable.tsx`) - Interactive table showing services with frequency dropdowns and remove buttons
- **ServiceSelectionModal Component** (`/components/ui/service-selection-modal.tsx`) - Modal for adding new services with duplicate prevention
- **CTABanner Component** (`/components/ui/cta-banner.tsx`) - Vibrant banner component for membership unlock messaging
- **LoadingScreen Component** (`/components/ui/loading-screen.tsx`) - Professional loading experience with Handld logo and brand spinner
- **Logo Component** (`/components/ui/logo.tsx`) - Reusable logo component with configurable size prop
- **BrandSpinner Component** (`/components/ui/brand-spinner.tsx`) - Reusable brand-consistent spinner with configurable size
- **WelcomeBanner Component** (`/components/ui/welcome-banner.tsx`) - Fixed welcome banner with personalized quote messaging
- **Admin Tools** (`/app/page.jsx`) - Internal testing interface for adding services to quotes
- **Airtable Integration** (`/lib/airtable.js`) - Server-side only utilities for Airtable API operations

### API Routes Structure
- `/api/quotes/[token]` - GET quote data by token, PUT to update line items and frequencies, DELETE to remove line items
- `/api/quotes/[token]/items` - POST to add new line items to quotes
- `/api/services` - GET available services for quote selection
- `/api/health/*` - Various health check endpoints
- `/api/debug/env` - Environment debugging endpoint
- `/api/version` - Version information endpoint

### Data Flow
1. Quotes are identified by unique tokens stored in Airtable
2. Quote data includes both header information (customer details) and line items (services)
3. Line items link to quotes via Quote ID field
4. The system supports both standard and member pricing tiers
5. Frequency selection updates line items and syncs "Selected Services" on quote headers
6. **Membership Requirement**: Handld member pricing is only available when 3+ services are selected

  - `--brand-navy: #2A54A1` (text and accent color)
  - `--brand-light-blue: #EFF6FF` (welcome banner and UI element backgrounds)
  - `--brand-light-red: #FEF2F2` (delete button backgrounds)
- Custom CSS utilities in `globals.css`:
  - `.spinner-brand` - Brand-consistent spinner styling with navy color and transparent gap
  - `.bg-brand-light-blue`, `.bg-brand-light-red` - Additional background utilities
- CSS Grid layout used for LineItemsTable (HTML tables had rendering issues)
- Responsive design with mobile-first approach
- Consistent `mb-4` spacing between all major sections
- **Color-coded UI Elements**: Different background colors for visual hierarchy and user feedback

- Interactive LineItemsTable with frequency selection dropdowns (1-12 monthly frequencies)
- Real-time frequency updates with optimistic UI and rollback on error
- Delete line items with confirmation dialog and optimistic updates
- **Add Service Functionality**: Modal-based service selection with duplicate prevention
- **Improved Service Addition**: Services are now added with their suggested frequency instead of defaulting to frequency 1
- Loading states per row with spinner animation during updates
- Toast notifications for success/error feedback using Radix UI Toast
- Confirmation dialogs for destructive actions (delete service)
- **Custom Hooks Architecture**: `useServices` and `useAddService` hooks for service management
- Debug mode available via `?debug=1` query parameter
- **Membership CTA System**: Dynamic CTA banner and button states based on service count
- **Stripe Booking Integration**: Functional booking buttons for both membership and a la carte purchases
- **Professional Icons**: Uses Lucide React icons throughout the UI for clean, consistent appearance
- **Enhanced Loading Experience**: Professional loading screen with Handld logo and rotating brand spinner
- **Reusable UI Components**: Logo and BrandSpinner components with configurable size props for consistency
- **Fixed Welcome Banner**: Persistent top banner with personalized quote messaging and value proposition
- **Enhanced Quote Header**: Larger logo (96px) with simplified title format and improved visual hierarchy

- Frequency dropdowns are fully functional with immediate Airtable updates
- Remove service buttons trigger confirmation dialog before deletion
- CSS Grid used for table layout due to HTML table rendering issues in some browsers
- Frequency dropdowns are compact (w-12) and prices are right-aligned for professional appearance

  - **< 3 services**: Orange/red gradient CTA banner with Sparkles icon, disabled membership button
  - **≥ 3 services**: Green gradient savings display with Trophy icon, enabled membership button

  - **Member Button**: Redirects to Stripe checkout for membership pricing (enabled with 3+ services)
  - **A La Carte Button**: Redirects to Stripe checkout with calculated total (enabled when services selected)

- **Extensive Test Coverage**: Quote page (96.29%), LineItemsTable component (95% coverage)

- Run tests with `npm test` or `npm run test:coverage`
